title: Majunu
desc: Vasanth, the son of a wealthy politician, falls in love with Heena. However, soon she becomes a suspect in a bomb blast, leading Vasanth to protect her, unaware of the dark secret that awaits him.

title: VeettukOru Kannagi
desc: Sujatha, a writer, is married to a police officer and leads a life with her daughter. Her life takes a drastic turn when her sister's husband murders her, along with her daughter.

title: Durga
desc: When a rich widow gets brutally killed, her daughter Durga, a young girl, sets out to avenge her mother's death with the help of her only friends a dog and a monkey.

title: Paadu Nilave
desc: When Balakrishnan, a police constable, expresses his love to a renowned singer, she rejects his advances. Balakrishnan feels insulted and decides to exact revenge on her.

title: Kaappaan
desc: Kathiravan is assigned to protect Prime Minister Chandrakanth Varma from terrorists. However, he is unsuccessful and takes it upon himself to find the killers.
